text:
amy: Quick poll: Office runs out of coffee or tea first?
josh: Coffee every time. The kettle is undefeated though.
li: Tea here — we keep emergency tea bags in the snack drawer like tiny life rafts.
megan: Can we have a truce and label personal mugs? I found a mystery latte in the fridge that tasted suspiciously like someone else's optimism.
amy: :poll: Vote with emoji — :coffee: coffee wins / :tea: tea wins
josh: :coffee: obviously. Also who refills the beans?
coffee-bot: Inventory alert: coffee beans low at 8kg. Next scheduled order in 3 days. To request immediate refill, post to #facilities. (automated)
li: Noted, I'll swing by the roastery partner tomorrow. Anyone want single-origin?
megan: I vote single-origin Guatemala, but decaf options too pls — allergies.
ajosh: Also: label mugs! Suggested system: name + pronouns + spirit animal. Thoughts?
amy: Name + emoji only pls. Spirit animal on a sticker is optional.
li: GIF: <link_to_morning-coffee-gif> caption: "Pre-standup status"
megan: Lost-and-found update: if you left a travel mug with a llama sticker, it's on the shelf by the fridge. Claim it before it develops opinions.
ajosh: Can we get a tiny sign: "Please don't microwave other people's coffee"? Real incident happened at 9:02am.
coffee-bot: Reminder: microwave etiquette saved 12 coworker friendships this quarter. :robot_face: (automated)
amy: Resolution: vote outcome — tallying. Also: mug-labeling station this Friday at 2pm; all welcome to decorate. Free tea for attendees.
li: I'll bring tea emergency kits. If coffee loses, we riot with biscotti.
josh: Final note: whoever keeps leaving soy milk in the meeting room fridge, you are a legend and also please put your name on it.
megan: Thread close: coffee slightly ahead in live votes, mug station scheduled, beans to be ordered if needed. Thanks all. :sparkles:
